note: Mixed page: lines 15-24 are the district Central Office Personnel list (printed headings 'Central Office Personnel', 'Student Services Office', 'Transportation Services', 'Cafeteria Services', 'Office of Facilities & Grounds', 'School Personnel/Business Services'), so school is central-office. Three columns; column of each person read from the heading order (left: Superintendent's office then Personnel/Business; middle: Student Services then Facilities & Grounds; right: Transportation then Cafeteria). Thomas Houle (line 19) recorded under Cafeteria Services as its Director -- the Student Services column has ended at line 18 and Facilities' heading is on line 20. 'McCarty Limousine' (line 16) is a transportation vendor, not a person, and is not recorded. Lines 1-14 are the district's guiding beliefs (tail), the elected School Committee (not staff) and meeting times; lines 25-53 the Superintendent's message (names in it are retirees/PTO, not a roster); line 54 is the page number.
